newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly easier in after-hours trade on Tuesday, pressured by sporadic profit-taking, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to unchanged from the day's close. Benchmark June was off 0.1 yen at 146.7 yen.
During the day, prices edged up amid the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar and improved technical factors.
Volume was thin with only 3,845 lots traded.
"Further gains are likely to be limited, as lacklustre buying interest in producing countries may cap prices," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity desk +81-3-3432-7431
